\[ 2 \text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g) \rightarrow 2 \text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \]

The standard enthalpy change of combustion is the enthalpy change when one mole of a substance burns in excess oxygen under standard conditions. Therefore, we need to calculate the enthalpy change for the reaction of one mole of H2.
